title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Android Build 278 (Swipe Tabs & Universal Edition)
highlights: Swipe Navigation Across Tabs: Easily transition between bottom navigation screens (Home <-> Sales <-> Parties <-> Items <-> More) with fluid left and right swipe gestures.
Form Field Validation Highlights: Missing required fields (such as Customer Name in Invoices, Quotations, and Job Sheets) are highlighted with a soft red fill and prominent red border.
Universal Business Edition: Fresh setups default to the Universal Business Edition for all retail and wholesale businesses with direct module unlock assistance (+91 8667237053).
Isolated Android Stream: In-app background updater downloads and installs Android APK packages directly with isolated manifests.
fixes: Implemented horizontal swipe gesture tab navigation across mobile views.
Added red outline validation and auto-focus for missing customer and form fields.
Replaced mobile-accessories default with Universal Business Edition onboarding.
